  • Honest coaching on Pakistan ties and bank trails
  • SECP-registered company + matching Google Business phone
  • Written scope: what you pay vs VFS/embassy fees

Common visit-file mistakes in Pakistan

  • Mixing study intent into a visitor story
  • Borrowed bank balances without a sponsor trail
  • Hotel bookings that do not match the cover letter
  • Wrong Schengen filing country (main destination rule)
  • Paying deposits to unverified numbers (always match /about/)

  2. Country checklist + fee scope in writing
  3. Ties / funds / invitation consistency check
